notes.currency: Amounts are never converted. Each currency is totalled on its own, so no exchange rate can go stale in this file.
notes.credits: Credit and access grants carry no money amount on purpose. Nobody paid a rate for them, so any figure would be invented. Usage is recorded instead.
notes.derived: Code contribution counts are not stored here. Commits, pull requests and issues are re-derivable from GitHub, and a hand-maintained copy would rot.
notes.privacy: Every entry carries a public flag. Amounts are shown unless a sponsor asks to stay anonymous.
notes.payments: No payment link is published in this repository.

provider.description: Built-in provider serving free model access to every OpenCrabs user
provider.note: The inference accounts funded below pay for this provider. Its identity is deliberately not disclosed and no link to it is published, so the accounts cannot be scraped or hammered. Do not name it, do not link it.

kinds.money: Money actually transferred. Summed per currency.
kinds.in-kind: A recurring subscription paid directly by a sponsor. Summed as rate times billings to date.
kinds.credits: Granted platform credits and early access. Never summed, usage recorded only.

replacement_rate.note: Current list price at time of writing. Recorded for context only, never summed into a total.
